name: Bloom Company
bio:
Bloom Company stands out in the world of tattoo artistry with their masterful expertise in the 'black&gray' style, showcasing an exceptional skill level that effortlessly brings each design to life. Their studio exemplifies cleanliness, maintaining a spotless environment that ensures every client’s experience is not only artistically rewarding but also upholds the highest standards of hygiene. As a veteran-owned and operated establishment, Bloom Company infuses professionalism into every aspect of their work, from the initial concept to the finished ink.
